question: Cherry Creek Estate avocado oil brand parent company
markdown:
Cherry Creek Estate operates as an independent, privately held producer and brand managed directly by its founders and directors, Angelo Leonardi and Managing Director Wayne Johnson, rather than being owned by
a larger corporate conglomerate
. The brand grows, presses, and bottles its 100% pure Australian avocado oil out of its orchards in Queensland, Australia.
